verdicts.defect: PodTerminal.sendText writes `${text}\r` as one stdin frame over the exec websocket. The UI gives no sign: the draft clears and the panel switches to Terminal exactly as it does on success. Sending the text and the return as two writes, or appending after a short delay, would fix it. (I cleared the three stuck messages out of the pod's prompt afterwards.)

verdicts.defect: It can lag: after the Undo button removed a file the badge still read the old number 6 seconds later and only caught up on the next read. Each refresh is a kubectl-style exec into the pod, so a few seconds is expected, but it is worth knowing.

verdicts.evidence: Clicked Files. Selected state moved to 'Files' and the visible body element changed to .assistant-panel__pane rendering ExtensionFiles: 'Branch main / Commits on main / 8a704fb The seeded extension / 26 hours ago' and the file tree (l10n/en-us.yaml, pages/Home.vue, routing/index.ts...). The commit sha matches git rev-parse HEAD in the pod.

Clicked Terminal. Selected state moved to 'Terminal' and the visible body element changed to the .assistant-panel__pane holding the xterm canvas stack (5 canvas elements). Typing into it reached the pod's tmux session - characters typed here appeared in tmux capture-pane -t mc-editor and Enter submitted them to claude.

The masthead reads 'base' over the eyebrow 'EXTENSION STUDIO'. It is the extension from the route ($route.params.extension, defaulted to DEFAULT_EXTENSION), and it is the one whose pod everything else on the screen reads: the same name appears on the context chip and in the preview's proxy URL (.../services/http:barn-base-extension:8005/proxy/).
No assistant turn is ever rendered. After sending three messages the Assistant tab still showed only the empty state; nothing echoed a plan, a lead sentence or a step list.
verdicts.defect: AssistantPanel.vue renders <ActivityTurn> only when its `turns` prop is non-empty, and editor.vue mounts <AssistantPanel> with no :turns binding (grep '\bturns\b' over pkg/barn: declared in AssistantPanel props, consumed in its v-for, never supplied). So turns.length is always 0 and the SEmpty state is permanent.

verdicts.evidence: Your own message is not echoed back. Sent 'CTXPROBE-03WS' - the draft cleared, the panel switched to Terminal, and the text appeared in the pod's terminal, but the Assistant tab's stream still showed only the empty state with no user bubble.
verdicts.defect: AssistantPanel.vue renders <ActivityTurn> only when its `turns` prop is non-empty, and editor.vue mounts <AssistantPanel> with no :turns binding (grep '\bturns\b' over pkg/barn: declared in AssistantPanel props, consumed in its v-for, never supplied). So turns.length is always 0 and the SEmpty state is permanent. The composer emits 'send' straight to the terminal and never records the message as a turn, so there is nothing for the stream to show even if it were being fed.

verdicts.evidence: Keyed to my own file so the result was unambiguous. Wrote /app/pkg/base/verify-03-workspace-b.txt in the pod, then clicked the masthead's Undo (data-testid=barn-undo-button). The toast read 'Undone - The last change to verify-03-workspace-b.txt has been undone.' and git status --porcelain in the pod no longer listed it; the file was gone from disk. Repeated once with verify-03-workspace.txt, same result. Other verifiers' files (BRIEF.md) were untouched, since undoLastChange takes only the most recently modified changed file.
verdicts.defect: The label is 'Undo' rather than the design's 'Undo last change', and the change count on the tab and summary strip does not refresh within about six seconds of the undo (it is right again on the next read). Neither is a failure of the promise.
